# ankra_aws_subnets (Data Source)

The subnets of an AWS VPC, for `node_subnet_ids` and `bastion_subnet_id` on `ankra_aws_cluster`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_aws_subnets" "private" {
  credential_id = ankra_aws_role_credential.main.id
  region        = "eu-central-1"
  vpc_id        = "vpc-0123456789abcdef0"
}

locals {
  nat_subnet_ids = [for subnet in data.ankra_aws_subnets.private.subnets : subnet.id if subnet.egress_kind == "nat_gateway"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.
- `region` (String) AWS region, e.g. `eu-central-1` (`data.ankra_aws_regions`).
- `vpc_id` (String) VPC id (`data.ankra_aws_vpcs`).

### Read-Only

- `subnets` (Attributes List) Subnets of the VPC. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

<a id="nestedatt--subnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `availability_zone` (String) Availability zone.
- `cidr` (String) IPv4 CIDR.
- `egress_kind` (String) Where the subnet's default route leads: `nat_gateway`, `nat_instance`, `internet_gateway`, `transit`, `none` or `unknown`.
- `id` (String) Subnet id.
- `map_public_ip_on_launch` (Boolean) Whether instances get a public IPv4 address on launch.
- `name` (String) Name tag.
